limitations: Result position projected onto the known arc is a geometric coordinate, not an observed server claim timestamp.
Replicated opponent poses are not server poses and do not reveal opponent action/input timestamps.
Native input requests and local contact callbacks do not guarantee server possession or tackle acceptance.
No production thresholds are changed by this audit.

Native floor-state changes are observed; the suspected opponent-body cause is not an instrumented native floor probe. A matched successful near-body swat retained nativeAirborne, so proximity does not guarantee failure.
No observation supplies the server reason for rejecting or losing a local catch claim.
Offline replays establish model/dispatch properties, not an authoritative counterfactual win.
